title: DreamLand
tagline: DreamLand is a virtual place where the users can can visit with their own NFT characters.
description: DreamLand makes use of Sequence wallet to onboard users to the Dapp. Once they are onboarded they can mint their own character. The minting is free with the integration of Sequence wallet. The metadata of the character NFT are stored on Lighthouse Storage. After the user mint their character they can now enter the DreamLand and check out different places.
how_its_made: This project uses Sequence Wallet for user login and character Minting. The NFT metadata is stored on Lighthouse storage. The link for the metadata of one of the character is : https://gateway.lighthouse.storage/ipfs/QmfJJkseCEZ4JGUBnBq8pa6KiQV2BmjSeBf98HFpuctmm5 . The NFT contract is deployed on polygon network : https://mumbai.polygonscan.com/address/0x80a6359bA5FF1e9ec1368cBA356a676C65f46497#code
